tools.name: classify_hts
tools.description: Find the US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification for a product. Returns candidate HTS codes with their official descriptions and base duty rates. Use when the user wants the code itself rather than a cost.

tools.name: policy_changes_since
tools.description: List US trade policy changes Gateway has published since a given date: new tariff actions, rate changes, effective dates and expirations. Use to answer "what changed recently" or "what is coming".
